import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check branch
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git branch && git log -1 --oneline")
print("Branch:", stdout.read().decode())
# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -2")
time.sleep(12)
# Test
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
